text: Something moves out there — Sweeps Week.
It followed you. The Sweeps Week is here.
The Sweeps Week stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Something pads into the clearing — Sweeps Week. It's here.
It followed you. The Sweeps Week is here.
